label.en: Liaison with funeral director, reception venue setup & AV check
Guest arrival, memorial booklets & seating assistance

q.en: Does Managevent replace a licensed funeral director?

a.en: No. Managevent does not perform regulated funeral-director services or care of the deceased. We work alongside your funeral director to manage the venue, wake catering, marquee/seating hire, tribute displays and guest RSVPs.
